preconditions.description: Number of online courses (n) and main courses (k) are within the specified range.
The number of main courses provided matches the value of k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= course <= n for course in main_courses)
preconditions.description: All main courses are within the valid range of course numbers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(dependencies) <= n-1 for dependencies in course_dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each course has a valid number of dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= dependency <= n for dependency in dependencies for dependencies in course_dependencies)
preconditions.description: All dependencies are within the valid range of course numbers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == 2 + min_courses and all(1 <= int(course) <= n for course in return_value.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no valid course order, or it consists of two lines: the first line is the minimum number of courses, and the second line is a list of course numbers in chronological order.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(course) in main_courses for course in return_value.split()[1:] if int(course) in main_courses)
postconditions.description: All main courses are included in the output if a valid course order exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(course) not in return_value.split()[1:] for course in range(1, n+1) if course not in main_courses and course not in [int(d) for dependencies in course_dependencies for d in dependencies])
postconditions.description: No unnecessary courses are included in the output if a valid course order exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(course) not in return_value.split()[1:] for course in range(1, n+1) if course not in main_courses and course not in [int(d) for dependencies in course_dependencies for d in dependencies])
postconditions.description: No unnecessary courses are included in the output if a valid course order exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(return_value.split()[1+i]) in [int(d) for d in course_dependencies[int(return_value.split()[1+i])-1]] for i in range(len(return_value.split())-2) if int(return_value.split()[1+i+1]) in course_dependencies[int(return_value.split()[1+i])-1])
postconditions.description: Each course in the output order satisfies its dependency requirements.
